messages.content:
Several readers answered the same question about machines at work, each pointing at the sentences it used. Decide which answer the evidence supports. Use only the evidence shown; do not use what you know.

Rules:
- An answer is supported only if its evidence states it for the exact subject asked about (the same device, the
  same article and paragraph, the same kind of verification, the same deadline, the same condition the question
  states). Evidence about a neighbouring subject does not support an answer.
- When the two rest on texts of different rank, the higher rank wins: law, then guidance, then manufacturer's
  manual, then company procedure, then plant record. Between two Italian texts, a legislative decree (D.Lgs.)
  wins over a ministerial decree (DM). A wording corrected by a corrigendum replaces the original wording.
- For a list, prefer the answer whose items are each stated by the evidence and that leaves none out.
- Readers that found nothing are listed too: when most readers found nothing and the one answer shown rests on evidence about a neighbouring subject, choose "none".
Return JSON only: {"reasoning": "two or three short sentences", "choice": <the number of the answer supported, or "none">}

Today is 2026-11-14.
Question: The manual of the MA STAR two post lift carries an EC declaration of conformity to Directive 2006/42/EC. For a unit of the same model placed on the market on 1 March 2027, must the CE marking be followed by the identification number of a notified body?

Answer 1 (given by 1 reader(s): facts): false
No: the Directive's Annex III rule (fact 4) applies only where the full quality assurance procedure was used, and the Directive is repealed from 20 January 2027 (Corrigendum point 5), so it cannot govern a unit placed on 1 March 2027.
Evidence:
- products placed on the market in conformity with Directive 2006/42/EC: placingAllowedUntil = 20 January 2027 (condition: placed on the market in conformity with Directive 2006/42/EC before 20 January 2027) | sentence: "read: ‘ 20 January 2027 ’." [CORR, Corrigendum, point 6]
- Directive 2006/42/EC: repealedFrom = 20 January 2027 | sentence: "read: ‘ 20 January 2027 ’." [CORR, Corrigendum, point 5]
- MA STAR two-post lift: conformsToStandard = 2006/42/EG | sentence: "VP 451194 Bezeichnung | Designation Zwei-Säulen-Hebebühne Two Post Lift Richtlinien | Directives 2006/42/EG 2006/42/EC 2014/53/EU 2014/53/EU Normen | Standards EN 1493:2022 EN 60204-1:2018 EN ISO 13849-1:2023 Bevollmächtigter für die Zusammenstellung der technischen Unterlagen Person Authorised to Compile the" [mastar-manual, p. 37]
- CE marking: hasObligation = must be followed by the identification number of the notified body (condition: Where the full quality assurance procedure referred to in Article 12(3)(c) and 12(4)(b) has been applied) | sentence: "Where the full quality assurance procedure referred to in Article 12(3)(c) and 12(4)(b) has been applied, the CE marking must be followed by the identification number of the notified body." [DIR, Annex III]

Answer 2 (given by 1 reader(s): search): true
Yes. For a vehicle servicing lift placed on the market on 1 March 2027, Regulation (EU) 2023/1230 applies (Directive 2006/42/EC was repealed from 20 January 2027, Art. 51(2)), and Art. 24(3) requires the notified body's identification number after the CE marking because the lift falls under Annex I, Part A, point 3 and Art. 25(2).
Evidence:
- Found by search: REG, Art. 51(2) (corrected by the corrigendum (Corrigendum, point 5: '14 January 2027' now reads '20 January 2027')) | sentence: "Article 51 Repeals. 2. Directive 2006/42/EC is repealed with effect from 20 January 2027." [REG, Art. 51(2)]
- Found by search: REG, Art. 52(1) (corrected by the corrigendum (Corrigendum, point 6: '14 January 2027' now reads '20 January 2027'; Corrigendum, point 7: '13 July 2023' now reads '19 July 2023')) | sentence: "Article 52 Transitional provisions. 1. Member States shall not impede the making available on the market of products which were placed on the market in conformity with Directive 2006/42/EC before 20 January 2027." [REG, Art. 52(1)]
- Found by search: REG, Art. 24(3) | sentence: "Article 24 Rules for affixing the CE marking to machinery and related products. 3. Where the conformity of machinery or a related product is assessed in accordance with the conformity assessment procedure referred to in Article 25(2), points (a), (b) and (c) and in Article 25(3), points (b), (c) and (d), the CE marking shall be followed by the identification number of the notified body involved in that procedure." [REG, Art. 24(3)]
- Found by search: REG, Annex I, Part A, point 3 | sentence: "3. Vehicle servicing lifts." [REG, Annex I, Part A, point 3]
- Found by search: REG, Art. 25(2) | sentence: "Article 25 Conformity assessment procedures for machinery and related products. 2. Where the category of machinery or related product is listed in Annex I, Part A, the manufacturer or the natural or legal person referred to in Article 18 shall apply one of the following procedures: (a) EU type-examination (module B) set out in Annex VII, followed by conformity to type based on internal production control (module C) set out in Annex VIII; (b) conformity based on full quality assurance (module H) set out in Annex IX; (c) conformity based on unit verification (module G) set out in Annex X." [REG, Art. 25(2)]

Readers that found nothing: words, similar

response.text:
Answer 2 is supported. The Corrigendum puts the repeal of Directive 2006/42/EC at 20 January 2027, so a unit placed on the market on 1 March 2027 falls under Regulation (EU) 2023/1230, not the Directive. Under the Regulation, vehicle servicing lifts are in Annex I, Part A, point 3, and the Art. 25(2) procedures all lead to Art. 24(3), which requires the notified body's number after the CE marking. Answer 1 relies on the Directive's Annex III, which no longer governs that unit.
